_doc: Reviewed labels that override the premises classifier for the conditions search page. Reviewed by an AI model reading each motion (not by a person), then checked by a second AI review.

decisions.address: 2050 Van Ness Av, San Francisco, Ca 94109
decisions.what: 63-unit apartment building with about 776 sq ft of ground-floor commercial space
decisions.reason: A whole-building housing project; the small commercial space is incidental and the conditions are about the building.

decisions.what: Grubstake, a restaurant with beer and wine, rebuilt on the ground floor of a new eight-story housing building and allowed to open 24 hours
decisions.reason: Part of the approval is for the restaurant itself (24-hour opening hours), and its conditions include the bona fide eating place, eating and drinking and odor conditions.

decisions.what: Saje Natural Wellness, an aromatherapy supply store
decisions.reason: A retail store with no food or drink.

decisions.what: Circle K convenience store in a gas station food mart
decisions.reason: A convenience store at a gas station; the motion says it does not intend to sell beer or wine.

decisions.what: SusieCakes Bakery, a chain bakery approved as a limited restaurant
decisions.reason: The motion approves a limited restaurant (a bakery selling food), which counts as restaurant or cafe.

decisions.what: H Mart grocery store
decisions.reason: A grocery store, which stays out even with restaurants inside.

decisions.what: Iyara Traditional Thai Massage
decisions.reason: A massage establishment, not food or drink.

decisions.what: Circle K convenience store at a 76 gas station
decisions.reason: A gas-station convenience store; the motion is about formula retail and does not involve alcohol or food service.

decisions.what: HUF skateboard clothing store
decisions.reason: A clothing store replacing a coffee shop, so the approved use is not food or drink.

decisions.what: Fig & Thistle, a cannabis store
decisions.reason: A cannabis store, not food or drink.

decisions.what: AMC Kabuki, a multiplex movie theatre
decisions.reason: Already on the page; this only corrects its business type from Restaurant or cafe, since it is a movie theatre and its conditions cover entertainment and hours.

decisions.what: Grocery Outlet grocery store
decisions.reason: A grocery store, which stays out.

decisions.what: Restaurant space converted to a real-estate office
decisions.reason: The motion converts a restaurant away to an office use.

decisions.what: Irving Pet Hospital expansion
decisions.reason: A pet hospital, not food or drink.

decisions.what: LYRIC, a community center for LGBTQQ youth
decisions.reason: A non-profit community facility; it even removes meal programs, and nothing in it is food, drink or entertainment.

decisions.what: Le Bamboo Wellness massage
decisions.reason: A massage establishment, not food or drink.

decisions.what: West Bay Pilipino Multi-Service Center
decisions.reason: The motion approves a social service and assembly use; the existing restaurant next door is left out of the project.

decisions.what: Cannabis store replacing a restaurant
decisions.reason: A cannabis store that converts a restaurant away from food.

decisions.what: Corona Heights Market and Deli, a small grocery store with an accessory deli
decisions.reason: A grocery store with a deli counter as an accessory use; grocery stores stay out.

decisions.what: Domino's Pizza, a chain take-out pizza restaurant
decisions.reason: The motion approves a formula retail restaurant selling take-out food.

decisions.what: A small grocery (a General Grocery use) moving an off-sale liquor licence
decisions.reason: Planning approved it as a General Grocery use, and grocery stores stay out.

decisions.what: Basanova cannabis store replacing a restaurant
decisions.reason: A cannabis store (sales only) that converts a restaurant away from food.

decisions.what: Cathay Bank branch
decisions.reason: A bank, not food or drink.

decisions.what: United Irish Cultural Center, a new community building with a restaurant, bar, ballroom and nighttime entertainment
decisions.reason: The motion approves restaurant, bar and nighttime entertainment uses, and its conditions include the eating and drinking, entertainment and bar-notice conditions, like the Nob Hill Masonic Center kept on the page.

decisions.what: RedMint massage
decisions.reason: A massage establishment, not food or drink.

decisions.what: Alchemy Springs health spa
decisions.reason: A health spa with an outdoor area; no food or alcohol service.

decisions.what: H Mart grocery store expansion
decisions.reason: A grocery store, which stays out.

decisions.what: Luke's Local grocery store
decisions.reason: A grocery store (with prepared foods and beer and wine), which stays out.

decisions.what: Mejuri jewelry store
decisions.reason: A jewelry store, not food or drink.

decisions.what: Valencia Whole Foods, a small family-owned grocery (a General Grocery use) taking over a beer and wine off-sale licence
decisions.reason: Planning approved it as a General Grocery use, and grocery stores stay out.

decisions.what: Just For You Bodywork & Massage
decisions.reason: A massage establishment, not food or drink.

decisions.what: The Gregangelo Museum, a folk-art house museum approved as a General Entertainment use for tours, private events and shows (10 am to 9:30 pm at the latest)
decisions.reason: No food or drink is served and it is not nighttime entertainment; the request was for food and drink. The classifier left it out too; this row records the call.

decisions.what: Chase bank branch replacing First Republic
decisions.reason: A bank, not food or drink.

decisions.what: AutoZone auto-parts store
decisions.reason: An auto-parts store, not food or drink.

decisions.what: Steps of Rome, an existing restaurant taking a full liquor license
decisions.reason: Already on the page; this only corrects its business type from Other food and drink, since the motion moves a Type 47 eating-place license to an existing restaurant.

decisions.what: Amal's Market, a grocery and deli of about 2,800 sq ft moving up from a beer and wine license to a full off-sale liquor license
decisions.reason: The motion is only about an off-sale liquor license at a small market (Planning treats it as a Liquor Store use and its conditions are the liquor store ones), so it counts as off-sale alcohol. Already on the page; this row records the grocery rule.

decisions.what: Total Wireless phone store
decisions.reason: A phone store, not food or drink.

decisions.what: Love Potion Library, a romance bookstore and tea room with wine service
decisions.reason: Already on the page; this only corrects its business type from Other food and drink, since the motion establishes a Bar use.

decisions.what: Whole Foods Market, a formula retail grocery store at 690 Stanyan Street, allowed to operate 24 hours a day
decisions.reason: The approved use is a General Grocery store (Whole Foods Market), which is excluded under the grocery rule even though the motion also addresses 24-hour operation. (Motion: "to place a grocery store in a building formerly occupied by a grocery store")

decisions.what: Baker and Banker restaurant at 1701 Octavia: adds self-service specialty food (baked goods, beverages) sales and extends hours.
decisions.reason: The motion approves a self-service specialty food use and changes to the existing full-service restaurant's hours, both food service uses under the rules. (Motion: "The proposed new use is for the incidental sales of baked goods and beverages, to the general public, from the existing restaurant kitchen")

decisions.what: Natural Health Center, a massage establishment at 2535A Taraval, modifying hours of operation
decisions.reason: The approved use is a massage establishment, which is excluded from the page, not a food, drink or entertainment use. (Motion: "to modify the hours of operation for the existing massage establishment (dba Natural Health Center)")

decisions.what: Specialty Food, Self Service use at 658 Vallejo Street: take-out deli, specialty foods and catering within an existing storefront, approved with conditions.
decisions.reason: Approved use is a Specialty Food, Self Service take-out deli, which is a self-service specialty food restaurant-type use selling prepared food to customers. (Motion: "establish a business offering specialty foods, a take‐out deli, and catering services")

decisions.what: La Parrilla Grill at 1760 Polk St, a full-service restaurant with a full bar, amended to extend hours from 10 pm to 2 am
decisions.reason: The motion approves an extension of hours for an existing full-service restaurant with a bar use, which is a change to an existing food and drink use. (Motion: "to allow expansion of hours of operation limited under Planning Commission Motion 17551 for an existing full-service restaurant and bar")

decisions.address: 1538 Situs To Be Assigned St, San Francisco, Ca 94117
decisions.what: Expansion of Haight Street Market grocery store into adjacent space formerly occupied by Massawa Restaurant, 1530-1538 Haight Street
decisions.reason: The approved use is a grocery store (Haight Street Market) expansion, and the restaurant space being absorbed is not approved as a food or drink use, so the grocery rule excludes it. (Motion: "propose to expand the existing grocery store (Haight Street Market) at 1530 Haight Street into the existing, adjacent commercial space")

decisions.what: Utoepia Spa, a nail salon adding foot massage chairs (a massage establishment) at 1722-1724 Divisadero St.
decisions.reason: The approved use is a massage establishment added to a nail salon, which is a personal service use outside the food, drink and entertainment categories. (Motion: "ADOPTING FINDINGS RELATING TO THE APPROVAL OF A CONDITIONAL USE AUTHORIZATION PURSUANT TO SECTIONS 303, 712.54, AND 790.60 OF THE PLANNING CODE TO ALLOW A MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENT")

decisions.what: Park Presidio 76 gas station at 4850 Geary converted to an automobile gas station with an accessory food mart
decisions.reason: The approved use is an automobile gas station; the accessory food mart is described as a retail grocery store use, which is excluded under the grocery rule and is not a food or drink service approval. (Motion: "The existing food mart establishment is an accessory retail grocery store use affiliated with the existing '76' service station")

decisions.what: Preservation Hall West: two full-service restaurant and bar establishments plus a jazz club (Other Entertainment) at 777 Valencia Street, with outdoor activity area
decisions.reason: The motion approves restaurant, bar and Other Entertainment (jazz club) uses together, and when restaurant, bar and entertainment uses are approved together the entertainment category applies. (Motion: "convert an existing vacant two-story building to two new Full-Service Restaurant & Bar Establishments on the ground floor, an Other Entertainment Establishment (Jazz Club)")

decisions.what: Tacolicious, a full-service restaurant and bar with outdoor seating at 741 Valencia Street, approved with conditions
decisions.reason: The motion approves a new full-service restaurant with a bar (type 47) and outdoor activity area, so it is a restaurant motion; the main service is food, so it is classed as Restaurant or cafe. (Motion: "to convert the vacant ground floor commercial unit of an existing two-story commercial and residential building to a new Full-Service Restaurant & Bar Establishment")

decisions.what: Medjool, a full-service restaurant, bar and other entertainment venue, legalizing a rooftop outdoor activity area
decisions.reason: The motion changes an existing use approved together as restaurant, bar and Other Entertainment, so the rules assign the entertainment type. (Motion: "to allow an existing Full‐Service Restaurant, Bar And Other Entertainment (d.b.a. Medjool) to legalize an Outdoor Activity Area")
decisions.review: reader (include, Nighttime entertainment) and checker (include, Bar) disagreed; claude-opus-5-5 decided, agreeing with the reader

decisions.what: Bun Mee, a large fast-food restaurant at 2015 Fillmore, allowed to add beer and wine service via amended conditional use
decisions.reason: The motion approves changes to an existing Large Fast-Food Restaurant use, removing the bar on alcohol sales for beer and wine, which is a food service use changed under the rules. (Motion: "the current owner proposes to serve beer and wine and has applied for a Type 41 ABC license")

decisions.what: InnerFog wine bar at 545 Irving St, amended to extend hours of operation to 10 a.m.-2 a.m. seven days a week
decisions.reason: The motion approves changes to an existing wine bar use (extended hours), and a wine bar is a Bar use, so it is included as Bar. (Motion: "to modify the conditions of a prior Conditional Use authorization under Case No. 2009.1048C (Motion No. 18014) to extend the hours of operation of an existing wine bar")

decisions.what: Monarch, a bar/entertainment venue at 101 6th Street, approved to intensify its entertainment use into the basement and extend hours to 4am
decisions.reason: The motion approves intensifying an existing entertainment use and extending bar and entertainment hours, so it is a change to a nighttime entertainment venue. (Motion: "intensify a non‐conforming entertainment use by expanding it to the basement level of the approximately 3,111 square‐foot bar")

decisions.what: Yogurtland, a formula retail self-serve frozen yogurt limited restaurant at 1250 Ocean Avenue, approved with conditions
decisions.reason: The motion approves a limited restaurant (self-serve frozen yogurt), a food use, so it belongs on the page as a restaurant or cafe. (Motion: "to establish a 1,615 square -foot, formula retail, limited-restaurant (d.b.a. "Yogurtland") witin the ground floor commercial space")

decisions.what: Speakeasy Ales and Lagers brewery expansion into adjacent warehouse storage space at 1195 Evans Avenue; storage only, no tasting room or on-site drinking described.
decisions.reason: Independent audit (2026-11-13) of the review: I couldn't refute the dispute. Motion 18701 grants a Conditional Use under Sec. 226(h) for a brewery use. Finding 6A says "The Project Sponsor is proposing a significant expansion to the existing brewery use". The use Planning approved is therefore the brewery (Speakeasy Ales and Lagers), expanded by 4,600 sq ft. The new space is only storage, but it stores the beer brewed on site, so it is part of the brewery use. …
decisions.review: reader and checker agreed; corrected by the independent audit

decisions.what: Red Vic Movie House converted to an Alembic Bar restaurant/bar expansion, an Other Entertainment event space and retail kiosks
decisions.reason: The motion approves a restaurant/bar expansion together with an Other Entertainment event space, and when restaurant, bar and entertainment uses are approved together the type is Nighttime entertainment. (Motion: "CREAT ION AN EVENT SPACE ALLOW ING “OTHER ENTERTAINMENT” IN THE FORMER MOVIE HOUSE AREA")
decisions.review: reader (include, Bar) and checker (include, Restaurant or cafe) disagreed; claude-opus-5-5 decided, agreeing with neither

decisions.what: American Conservatory Theater second stage: conversion of a former movie theater into a 299-seat live theater with a ground-floor restaurant/cafe fronting Market Street
decisions.reason: The motion approves conversion of the building into a live entertainment theater, which is an entertainment use, and the ground-floor restaurant/cafe is also approved, so the entertainment use governs the business type. (Motion: "to allow conversion of vacant commercial space previously occupied by a movie theater (d.b.a. Strand Theater) into a live entertainment theater (d.b.a. ACT Second Stage)")

decisions.what: The Pour House, a wine store with tasting room and bar at 1327 Polk St; Conditional Use to clarify continuation of the liquor store and bar, with hours extended to 2 a.m. in conditions.
decisions.reason: The motion approves a Bar use (wine tasting room and bar, clarified as liquor store and bar), and drinking is a main service, so it is a bar motion. (Motion: "to clarify the continuation of the existing wine store, tasting room and bar (liquor store and bar) (d.b.a. The Pour House)")

decisions.what: Sushi Avenue, a formula retail limited restaurant inside the Lucky grocery store at Lakeshore Plaza, legalized
decisions.reason: The motion approves a formula retail limited restaurant (Sushi Avenue), a food use, not the grocery store itself, so it is included as a restaurant. (Motion: "to allow the legalization of a formula retail limited restaurant , ( d.b.a. Sushi Avenue ) inside the existing Luckys grocery store")

decisions.address: 1096 South Van Ness Av, San Francisco, Ca
decisions.what: Urban Putt, a restaurant with indoor miniature golf course, with extended hours, at 1096 South Van Ness Avenue
decisions.reason: The motion approves a restaurant together with a miniature golf entertainment use and extended hours, so it is an entertainment approval, and the restaurant and entertainment uses together map to Nighttime entertainment. (Motion: "to allow an approximately 9,500 gross square foot restaurant and miniature golf establishment (d.b.a. Urban Putt) with extended hours")

decisions.what: Sur La Table, a formula retail cookware store with an accessory cooking class area, approved on Union Street
decisions.reason: The approved use is a formula retail cookware store with a cooking class, which is retail rather than a restaurant, cafe, bar or entertainment use. (Motion: "to allow a new Formula Retail establishment (d.b.a. Sur La Table ) within the Union Street NCD")

decisions.what: 2701-2703 Folsom St: vacant ground-floor spaces approved as a Buddhist meditation center (religious institution) and a small retail use.
decisions.reason: The motion itself approves a religious institution and a retail use, not a restaurant, bar or entertainment use; Planning's restaurant description does not match the motion text. (Motion: "to establish an approximately 2,400 square-foot religious institution and an approximately 400 square -foot retail use")
decisions.review: reader (exclude) and checker (include, Restaurant or cafe) disagreed; claude-opus-5-5 decided, agreeing with the reader

decisions.what: Nike retail apparel store (Formula Retail) replacing Rugby at 2071 Union Street, a retail apparel use.
decisions.reason: The approved use is a Formula Retail apparel store (Nike), which is retail rather than a restaurant, bar, or entertainment use. (Motion: "to convert a vacant ground floor commercial space with approximately 3,500 gross square feet of floor area (previously occupied by "Rugby"")

decisions.what: Valley Tavern, an existing bar, seeks legalization of its rear patio as an outdoor activity area with 24 patrons seating.
decisions.reason: The motion approves an expansion of an existing bar use (Valley Tavern, type 48 ABC license) through an outdoor activity area, so it is a change to a drink use. (Motion: "to allow for the expansion of a bar use (d.b.a. Valley Tavern) through the legalization of an outdoor activity area located within the rear yard")

decisions.what: Rag and Bone, a formula retail apparel store at 2060 Fillmore Street, approved with conditions
decisions.reason: The approved use is an apparel store (formula retail), not a restaurant, bar, or entertainment use. (Motion: "The subject use will be an apparel store (d.b.a. Rag and Bone).")

decisions.what: CVS Pharmacy formula retail pharmacy store at 1900 19th Avenue, change of use from former post office, approved with conditions.
decisions.reason: The approved use is a pharmacy store (retail), not a restaurant, bar, or entertainment use; the motion's conditions cover alcohol and tobacco sales only as incidental retail, not as a food or drink use. (Motion: "establish a 17,920 gross square foot formula retail pharmacy store (d.b.a. CVS Pharmacy)")

decisions.what: America's Best Value Inn motel at 2322 Lombard converted to tourist hotel, with a 4th floor addition and legalized guest rooms
decisions.reason: The approved use is a tourist hotel and building project, not a food, drink or entertainment use; the existing small cafe is not what Planning approved. (Motion: "to allow the conversion of use from a motel to a tourist hotel (d.b.a. America's Best Value Inn and Suites Golden Gate)")

decisions.what: Jones restaurant at 620 Jones St, modifying conditions to extend outdoor activity area hours to 2:00 a.m. Fridays/Saturdays and permit outdoor live entertainment until 7 p.m. daily
decisions.reason: The motion modifies conditions for an existing restaurant (d.b.a. Jones) and its outdoor activity area hours and live entertainment, so it concerns a food service use and its operating conditions. (Motion: "to extend the permitted hours of operation for an existing outdoor activity area until 2:00 a.m. on Fridays, Saturdays, New Year's Eve, and Gay Pride Sunday")

decisions.what: CVS Pharmacy formula retail store at 3600 Geary Blvd, a pharmacy selling drugs, household items and limited convenience grocery; no alcohol or tobacco.
decisions.reason: The approved use is a pharmacy/retail store, not a restaurant, bar, entertainment venue or liquor store; limited convenience grocery items do not make it a food or drink use. (Motion: "will sell a range of household and personal items such as prescription and over- the-counter drugs, health and beauty products")

decisions.what: Transfer of a Type 21 off-sale alcohol license from New Santa Clara Market to Santa Clara Natural Organic Market, a grocery store
decisions.reason: The approved use is a grocery store receiving an alcohol license, and under the grocery rule a grocery is out even for an alcohol licence; no Liquor Store or food service use is approved. (Motion: "to allow the transfer of an Off -Sale General alcoholic beverage license between two grocery stores")
decisions.review: reader (include, Other food and drink) and checker (exclude) disagreed; claude-opus-5-5 decided, agreeing with the checker

decisions.what: Tom Rai, a restaurant replacing Bliss Bar with a Type 47 license and existing place of entertainment, enlarged to 2,695 sq ft at 4022-4026 24th St
decisions.reason: The motion approves a new restaurant (Tom Rai, Type 47 ABC license) and maintains a place of entertainment, so it is a food and entertainment use; the restaurant is the main approved use, with the entertainment use also approved. (Motion: "to allow a 1,906 square foot, ground floor commercial space, formerly occupied by a bar use (d.b.a. Bliss Bar) to be enlarged beyond the use size limitation for the District to approximately 2,695 square feet and converted into a restaurant (d.b.a. Tom Rai)")

decisions.what: SkinSpirit, a personal service with accessory medical service (cosmetic injections, laser) replacing a toy store at 3325 Sacramento St, approved with conditions
decisions.reason: The approved use is a Personal Service with accessory Medical Service, not a food, drink or entertainment use, so it falls under the excluded beauty and clinic category. (Motion: "a change of use from a Retail toy store (d.b.a. The Ark) to a Retail and Personal Service use with accessory Medical Service (d.b.a. SkinSpirit)")

decisions.what: Ferry Plaza Seafood, a bona fide restaurant, allowed to upgrade its liquor license from Type 41 beer and wine to Type 47 general
decisions.reason: The approved use is an upgraded liquor license for an existing bona fide eating place restaurant, so food service remains the main use under the restaurant rules. (Motion: "to allow an upgrade from ABC License Type 41 (Restaurant, Beer and Wine) to Type 47 (Restaurant, General) at an existing Restaurant (d.b.a. Ferry Plaza Seafood) operating as a Bona Fide Eating Place")

decisions.what: First Republic Bank, a Formula Retail financial service replacing a vacant former restaurant space at 1699 Van Ness Ave.
decisions.reason: The approved use is a financial service (bank), not a food, drink or entertainment use, so it falls outside the page's scope. (Motion: "Conditional Use Authorization request to change of use from vacant retail (Restaurant) to a new Formula Retail Financial Service (First Republic Bank).")

decisions.what: 45RPM, a Japanese clothing retailer, Formula Retail use in Upper Fillmore NCD
decisions.reason: The approved use is a clothing retailer, which is other retail, not a food, drink or entertainment use. (Motion: "to establish the establishment of a Formula Retail use (a clothing retailer dba "45RPM") in the existing tenant space")

decisions.what: Fiesta Laundromat at 898 South Van Ness, a self-service laundromat, allowed to extend hours to 2-6 a.m. and legalize 24-hour operation
decisions.reason: The approved use is a self-service laundromat, which is a retail service use rather than a restaurant, bar, entertainment venue, or liquor store. (Motion: "The Project Sponsor proposes to extend the permitted hours of operation to operate between the hours of 2:00 a.m. and 6:00 a.m. for an existing self-service Laundromat")

decisions.what: North East Medical Services clinic replacing a former limited restaurant at 1441 Ocean Ave, with social service on third floor and vertical addition
decisions.reason: The approved use is a medical service and social service institution, not a food, drink or entertainment use; the prior restaurant is being converted into another use. (Motion: "proposes to open a new medical service use and social service establishment d.b.a. North East Medical Services")

decisions.what: Black Sands Brewery, a brew pub restaurant at 701 Haight St, allowed to extend hours to midnight Sun-Thu and 2 a.m. Fri-Sat
decisions.reason: The approved use is an existing brew pub restaurant with a restaurant liquor licence, and the motion extends its hours, which is a change to an existing food use. (Motion: "to allow a brew pub/restaurant (d.b.a. Black Sands Brewery) to extend hours of operation from 11 p.m. to midnight (12 a.m.)")

decisions.what: Reactivation of a ground-floor LCU commercial tenant space at 4529 18th Street, previously an interior designer office/showroom, under Planning Code 186(g).
decisions.reason: The approved use is an architect/interior designer office and showroom, which is an office use rather than a restaurant, bar, or entertainment use. (Motion: "The Project Sponsor proposes continuing the same type of use (architect/designer office/showroom) at this commercial location.")

decisions.what: Local Method, a restaurant with a micro brewery bar at 323 Octavia St, approved to exceed use size limit
decisions.reason: The motion approves a new restaurant use (Local Method) with a micro brewery bar component, and its conditions govern running that food and drink use including hours and odor control. (Motion: "to establish a new Restaurant Use (d.b.a. "Local Method") within a vacant, ground-floor tenant space")

decisions.what: EagleRider, a Formula Retail motorcycle sales and rental use at 3146 Mission Street, approved with conditions
decisions.reason: The approved use is motorcycle sales and rental (Automobile Sale or Rental, non-automotive vehicle rental), which is not a food, drink or entertainment use. (Motion: "to establish a Formula Retail motorcycle sales and rentals use (dba EagleRider) within an 19,640 square foot ground-floor")

decisions.what: Verizon Wireless retail store, a formula retail wireless communications shop, at 2162 Union Street
decisions.reason: The approved use is a wireless communications retail store, which is ordinary retail rather than a restaurant, bar, entertainment or liquor use, so it falls outside the page. (Motion: "Formula Retail Use (d.b.a. Verizon, a wireless communications retail store)")

decisions.what: Sav Mor Market, an existing liquor establishment/grocery store relocated to 4522 3rd Street in the Third Street Alcohol Restricted Use District
decisions.reason: Independent audit (2026-11-13) of the review: I couldn't refute the dispute. The grocery rule says the use Planning approved decides. Rule 1 only excludes a motion that approves a General or Specialty Grocery use, and the reviewers' reason depends on a "General Grocery use" label that does not appear anywhere in Motion 20076 (M-20076.pdf, read in full). The only Code finding that triggers the Conditional Use is §249.62(a)(3)(B)(iv): relocating an existing …
decisions.review: reader and checker agreed; corrected by the independent audit

decisions.what: Tian Yun Clinic at 372 7th Avenue, a medical service with an accessory massage establishment, legalized with conditions
decisions.reason: The approved use is a Medical Service with accessory massage, which is a massage/health use rather than a restaurant, bar, or entertainment use, so it falls outside the page's scope. (Motion: "Conditional Use Authorization to establish an accessory Massage Establishment with the existing acupuncture clinic.")

decisions.what: Denied Conditional Use to legalize an outdoor activity area for two bar uses (Trademark & Copyright) at 1123-1127 Folsom Street
decisions.reason: The motion is a denial of an outdoor activity area serving two existing bar uses, and denied food or drink uses count as in scope, with the approved use being a Bar. (Motion: "to legalize and establish an outdoor activity area measuring approximately 728 square feet in size in the rear of two existing bar uses")

decisions.what: The Slanted Door (Dosa), a full-service restaurant at 580-584 Valencia, approved to add bar service with a Type 47 ABC license
decisions.reason: Independent audit (2026-11-13) of the review: I could not refute the dispute. Motion 18402 (2010.1070C) grants a Conditional Use under Planning Code Sections 303, 726.41 and 790.22. Section 726.41 is the Bar line in the Valencia NCT table, and 790.22 defines a Bar. The motion's title says the purpose is "to authorize the addition of bar service (Type 47 ABC license)" to an existing full-service restaurant. The project description adds that under Section 790.92 …
decisions.review: reader and checker agreed with the classifier; corrected by the independent audit

decisions.what: 1650 Mission St: change of former limited-restaurant space to Public (office) use plus a retained limited-restaurant space of about 1,000 sq ft
decisions.reason: Independent audit (2026-11-13) of the review: I could not refute the dispute. The motion's own wording settles it. The title and the Exhibit A authorization approve only "a conditional use to allow a Public (office) use located at 1650 Mission Street" under Sec. 731.83. The finding states the request is "a change of use from a limited-restaurant to Public use". The 1,000 sq ft of limited-restaurant space is called "retained" and "existing". It is not something …
decisions.review: reader and checker agreed with the classifier; corrected by the independent audit

decisions.what: Prohibition, a 3,008 sq ft restaurant and lounge with up to 200 sq ft of other entertainment (DJ, live performances) replacing a bar and adult entertainment use at 493 Broadway.
decisions.reason: Independent audit (2026-11-13) of the review: I couldn't refute the dispute. Prohibition belongs on the page as Restaurant or cafe, not Nighttime entertainment. 1. The Authorization section of Motion 19616 (Exhibit A) reads "conditional use to allow a restaurant exceeding 2,999 square feet (d.b.a. Prohibition)" under Sections 303, 714.21 and 714.44 only. The title and preamble say the same. 2. The motion did not authorize the entertainment. Finding 6.C says …
decisions.review: reader and checker agreed with the classifier; corrected by the independent audit

decisions.what: Whole Foods Market at 1150 Ocean Ave, a formula retail grocery store, allowed an on-sale beer and wine (Type 41) license for its bona fide eating area.
decisions.reason: Independent audit (2026-11-13) of the review: I could not refute the dispute. The motion (M-19713) approves only a General Grocery use, and grocery rule 1 in REVIEWED.md keeps that out. Its authorization paragraph says the conditional use is "to allow an on-sale liquor license (Type 41) at an existing formula retail grocery store (d.b.a. Whole Foods)". The CUA was needed only because the 2006 approval (Motion 17885) carried a condition banning on-sale licences. …
decisions.review: reader and checker agreed with the classifier; corrected by the independent audit

decisions.what: Geneva Car Barn/Powerhouse at 500 Geneva Ave: adaptive reuse as youth-arts community facility with exhibition space, retail and a restaurant
decisions.reason: Independent audit (2026-11-13) of the review: I could not refute the dispute. Motion M-19559 (pdf/4474047901c588ec2b511129.pdf) grants a Conditional Use under Planning Code sections 211.2 and 303 for a community facility in the P (Public Use) District. Its project description says the authorization "would approve phase 1 scope of work at the Powerhouse", which is a 300-person, roughly 2,058 sf exhibition space. The best case for keeping it is Exhibit A: its …
